messages.subject: Methylation QTL mapping
parts:
Dear group members, 

I've been using R/QTL to map phenotypic traits and I love this program. 
I wanted to know if it was possible to map methylation data (from bisulfite sequencing) on SNP data (methylation QTL)?
If it is not possible with R/QTL, what R package can do that?
Most of papers doing this kind of analysis used a standard linear regression approach but with do not provide any methods...

Thanks! 

Jo

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Methylation QTL mapping
parts:
If you turn the methylation information into quantitative phenotypes, you should be able to use them for QTL mapping as with any other trait.

karl
